recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7464 unless a later work group decision specifically changes how CompartmentDefinition canonical URLs are displayed.
issue_request: FHIR-7464 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core issue from the 2015May/DSTU1 ballot asking whether patient compartment searches should use lowercase `/patient` or uppercase `/Patient`; the accepted resolution required uppercase `/Patient`, cleanup of leftover lowercase examples, and removal of old compartment URI presentation.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 5671. The corresponding git commit is ac324ca8a1a86de1d9990a1288aff1720fc0ab6a (`#7464 - compartment documentation improvements`), which changed the search page example from `GET [base]/patient/[id]/[ResourceType]` to `GET [base]/Patient/[id]/[ResourceType]`, capitalized nearby `/patient` examples, moved `extras.html` to `compartments.html`, and removed the compartment URI column from the compartment list.
additional_context: CompartmentDefinition is active in the current build via `source/fhir.ini`, and the relevant current source is now under `source/compartmentdefinition` plus `source/compartments.xml`. Current rendered and source artifacts may expose a Formal URI because CompartmentDefinition.url is mandatory canonical metadata in the modern resource model; that is distinct from the old endpoint casing ambiguity and should not be removed under this Jira.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source has uppercase `/Patient` compartment examples and source search found no lowercase `[base]/patient` endpoint examples to correct.
